requirements.statement: Each bitmap image (<canvas>) that carries information meets one of the listed conditions.

citations.quote: Chaque image bitmap (balise `<canvas>`) porteuse d’information, vérifie-t-elle une de ces conditions ?

routes.statement: The <canvas> has a text alternative (aria-labelledby or aria-label) and role="img".

citations.quote: La balise `<canvas>` possède une alternative textuelle et un attribut `role="img"` ;
Vérifier que la balise ouvrante `<canvas>` est pourvue au moins d’une alternative textuelle parmi les suivantes :

routes.statement: Alternative content is present between the <canvas> and </canvas> tags; the methodology's note says it cannot serve a <canvas> that has role img.

citations.quote: Un contenu alternatif est présent entre les balises `<canvas>` et `</canvas>` ;
si l'élément `<canvas>` dispose d'un rôle `img`, son alternative ne peut être fournie que par les techniques listées à l'étape 4.

routes.statement: The <canvas> is immediately followed by an adjacent link or button to alternative content.

citations.quote: L’élément `<canvas>` est immédiatement suivi d’un lien ou bouton adjacent permettant d’accéder à un contenu alternatif ;
le lien ou bouton doit se situer juste avant ou juste après l’élément auquel il est adjacent

routes.statement: A mechanism lets the user replace the <canvas> with alternative content.

citations.quote: Un mécanisme permet à l’utilisateur de remplacer l’élément `<canvas>` par un contenu alternatif.

exceptions.statement: An image that is the only content of a link has the link's text as its alternative, and the glossary sends that alternative to the Links theme.

citations.quote: lorsque l’image est le seul contenu d’un lien, son alternative est l’intitulé du lien. Dans ce cas, l’alternative de l’image devrait être évaluée avec la thématique « Liens ».

exceptions.statement: A <canvas> that is the only content of a <button> has the button's text as its alternative, and the glossary sends it to the Forms or Scripts theme.

citations.quote: lorsqu’un bouton de formulaire, inséré avec l’élément

rationale.text: The test accepts four conditions, so its one requirement has four routes: a text alternative (aria-labelledby or aria-label) with role="img", alternative content between the <canvas> tags, an adjacent link or button to alternative content, or a mechanism to replace the element. The methodology validates the test on the first, and otherwise on any of the other three. Its note says that a <canvas> with role img can get its alternative only from aria-labelledby or aria-label, so the content-between-tags route does not serve such a canvas. The note may also be read as closing the adjacent-link and mechanism routes to it; the entry does not decide that, and it changes no level. The glossary notes on images alone in a link or a <button> (which names <canvas>) are exceptions: the image's alternative is the link's or the button's text and is evaluated in another theme. No axe rule is tagged for this test. A fault would need every route to fail, and three of them need judgment: whether content between the tags, or behind an adjacent link, brings the same information as the canvas (the glossary gives a data table for a chart as an example), and whether a replacement mechanism exists. Whether the canvas carries information is judgment too. So no check resolves the requirement or proves a failure, and the entry is none with no link. Applicability is judgment, since it depends on which canvases carry information. Needs is empty: the methodology asks for no interaction or assistive technology.
